scope: Batch 10 extraction from the untagged 2020 Zendikar Rising Magic Story episodes and side stories, plus the 2020 'Zendikar: Things Have Changed' world feature. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; targeted, not exhaustive; not owner approved.

claims.subject: sorin_markov

quotes.quote: Nahiri turned and was faced with her old mentor. Her sworn enemy.

claims.summary: Sorin is Nahiri's old mentor and sworn enemy; he confronts her on Zendikar.
claims.limitation: The quoted sentences precede the line naming him ("Sorin."), which is shorter than the quote minimum.

claims.subject: nissa_revane

quotes.quote: And easily, so easily, Nissa's magic merged with the Core's power.

claims.summary: Nissa channels the Lithoform Core's power with her own magic.

claims.subject: nahiri

quotes.quote: She should have found a different plane to trap the Eldrazi in millennia ago.

claims.summary: Nahiri helped trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar millennia ago.
claims.limitation: Point-of-view narration; the pronoun's referent is the viewpoint character named in the summary, not named in the quoted sentence.

claims.subject: ulamog

quotes.quote: Zendikar's Vampires were created many centuries ago by a magical infection that originated from the Eldrazi and enslaved them to Ulamog's will.

claims.summary: Zendikar's vampires were created by an Eldrazi-born infection that enslaved them to Ulamog's will.

claims.subject: ondu_skyclave

claims.subject: lorthos

claims.limitation: The page itself leaves open whether it was Lorthos or an ancestor.
